mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, which may lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates suggest a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 30% of cases when UNRATE is below 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases by more than 5% month-over-month, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate increases and the federal funds rate is high, it may indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 30% of cases when both UNRATE increases and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production suggests strong economic output, which may lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO increases by more than 1% month-over-month, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL may lead to tighter monetary policy, which could negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 30% of cases when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth slows and unemployment rises, it may indicate economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 30% of cases when GDPC1 growth slows and UNRATE increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High retail and food services sales suggest strong consumer demand, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when RSAFS increases by more than 5% month-over-month, the hypothesis is rejected.
